description: A series of compact encoding schemes for building small and fast parsers and serializers

sections.title: Usage

methods.name: state

params.name: end
params.description: =0] - Initial end offset (set by preencode to determine required buffer size).

methods.returns: A new state object `{ start, end, buffer }`.
methods.description: Create a blank encoder state object.
examples:
const cenc = require('compact-encoding')
const state = cenc.state()
cenc.uint.preencode(state, 42)
cenc.string.preencode(state, 'hi')
state.buffer = Buffer.allocUnsafe(state.end)
cenc.uint.encode(state, 42)
cenc.string.encode(state, 'hi')

methods.name: raw
methods.description:
Pass-through encoder that reads/writes raw bytes without a length prefix.
Also acts as a namespace for raw (unprefixed) variants of all bundled encodings
(e.g. `cenc.raw.buffer`, `cenc.raw.uint8array`, `cenc.raw.string`).

methods.name: uint
methods.description:
Encoder for unsigned integers using the smallest fixed-size encoding with a
1-byte prefix to signal which width was chosen (1, 3, 5, or 9 bytes).
Useful for uints that span a wide range of values.

methods.name: uint8
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size 8-bit unsigned integer (1 byte).

methods.name: uint16
methods.description:
Encoder for a fixed-size 16-bit unsigned integer (2 bytes, little-endian).
Useful for port numbers.

methods.name: uint24
methods.description:
Encoder for a fixed-size 24-bit unsigned integer (3 bytes, little-endian).
Useful for message framing.

methods.name: uint32
methods.description:
Encoder for a fixed-size 32-bit unsigned integer (4 bytes, little-endian).
Useful for very large message framing.

methods.name: uint32be
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size 32-bit unsigned integer (4 bytes, big-endian).

methods.name: uint40
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size 40-bit unsigned integer (5 bytes, little-endian).

methods.name: uint48
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size 48-bit unsigned integer (6 bytes, little-endian).

methods.name: uint56
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size 56-bit unsigned integer (7 bytes, little-endian).

methods.name: uint64
methods.description:
Encoder for a fixed-size 64-bit unsigned integer (8 bytes, little-endian).
Values are stored as JavaScript numbers; for precision beyond `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` use `cenc.biguint64`.

methods.name: uint64be
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size 64-bit unsigned integer (8 bytes, big-endian).

methods.name: int
methods.description:
Encoder for signed integers using `cenc.uint` with ZigZag encoding.
Uses the smallest fixed-size prefix-signalled encoding.

methods.name: int8
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size signed 8-bit integer using `cenc.uint8` with ZigZag encoding.

methods.name: int16
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size signed 16-bit integer using `cenc.uint16` with ZigZag encoding.

methods.name: int24
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size signed 24-bit integer using `cenc.uint24` with ZigZag encoding.

methods.name: int32
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size signed 32-bit integer using `cenc.uint32` with ZigZag encoding.

methods.name: int40
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size signed 40-bit integer using `cenc.uint40` with ZigZag encoding.

methods.name: int48
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size signed 48-bit integer using `cenc.uint48` with ZigZag encoding.

methods.name: int56
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size signed 56-bit integer using `cenc.uint56` with ZigZag encoding.

methods.name: int64
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size signed 64-bit integer using `cenc.uint64` with ZigZag encoding.

methods.name: biguint64
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size 64-bit unsigned BigInt (8 bytes, little-endian).

methods.name: bigint64
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed-size signed 64-bit BigInt using `cenc.biguint64` with ZigZag encoding.

methods.name: biguint
methods.description: Encoder for an arbitrary-precision unsigned BigInt with its 64-bit word count uint-prefixed.

methods.name: bigint
methods.description: Encoder for an arbitrary-precision signed BigInt using `cenc.biguint` with ZigZag encoding.

methods.name: lexint
methods.description:
Lexicographically-sortable variable-length integer encoder.
Encoded byte sequences sort in the same order as their numeric values, making
them suitable for ordered key-value stores.

methods.name: float32
methods.description: Encoder for a 32-bit IEEE 754 floating-point number (4 bytes, little-endian).

methods.name: float64
methods.description: Encoder for a 64-bit IEEE 754 floating-point number (8 bytes, little-endian).

methods.name: buffer
methods.description:
Encoder for a `Buffer`/`Uint8Array` with its byte length uint-prefixed.
When decoding a zero-length buffer, `null` is returned.

methods.name: optionalBuffer
methods.description:
Encoder for an optional `Buffer`/`Uint8Array` with its byte length uint-prefixed.
A `null` or falsy value encodes as a single zero byte; decodes back to `null`.

methods.name: binary
methods.description:
Encoder that accepts either a `Buffer`/`Uint8Array` or a `string` (encoded as UTF-8),
with its byte length uint-prefixed. Useful when the value type is not known at write time.

methods.name: arraybuffer
methods.description: Encoder for an `ArrayBuffer` with its byte length uint-prefixed.

methods.name: uint8array
methods.description: Encoder for a `Uint8Array` with its element count uint-prefixed.

methods.name: uint16array
methods.description: Encoder for a `Uint16Array` with its element count uint-prefixed.

methods.name: uint32array
methods.description: Encoder for a `Uint32Array` with its element count uint-prefixed.

methods.name: int8array
methods.description: Encoder for an `Int8Array` with its element count uint-prefixed.

methods.name: int16array
methods.description: Encoder for an `Int16Array` with its element count uint-prefixed.

methods.name: int32array
methods.description: Encoder for an `Int32Array` with its element count uint-prefixed.

methods.name: biguint64array
methods.description: Encoder for a `BigUint64Array` with its element count uint-prefixed.

methods.name: bigint64array
methods.description: Encoder for a `BigInt64Array` with its element count uint-prefixed.

methods.name: float32array
methods.description: Encoder for a `Float32Array` with its element count uint-prefixed.

methods.name: float64array
methods.description: Encoder for a `Float64Array` with its element count uint-prefixed.

methods.name: string
methods.description:
Encoder for a UTF-8 string with its byte length uint-prefixed.
Also exported as `cenc.utf8`. Supports a `.fixed(n)` method to create a fixed-width variant.

methods.name: utf8
methods.description:
Encoder for a UTF-8 string with its byte length uint-prefixed.
Also exported as `cenc.utf8`. Supports a `.fixed(n)` method to create a fixed-width variant.

methods.name: ascii
methods.description:
Encoder for an ASCII string with its byte length uint-prefixed.
Supports a `.fixed(n)` method to create a fixed-width variant.

methods.name: hex
methods.description:
Encoder for a hex string with its byte length uint-prefixed.
Supports a `.fixed(n)` method to create a fixed-width variant.

methods.name: base64
methods.description:
Encoder for a base64 string with its byte length uint-prefixed.
Supports a `.fixed(n)` method to create a fixed-width variant.

methods.name: ucs2
methods.description:
Encoder for a UTF-16LE string with its byte length uint-prefixed.
Also exported as `cenc.utf16le`. Supports a `.fixed(n)` method.

methods.name: utf16le
methods.description:
Encoder for a UTF-16LE string with its byte length uint-prefixed.
Also exported as `cenc.utf16le`. Supports a `.fixed(n)` method.

methods.name: bool
methods.description: Encoder for a boolean value stored as a single byte (`1` for `true`, `0` for `false`).

methods.name: fixed

params.name: n
params.description: Exact number of bytes to encode/decode.

methods.returns: An encoder that reads and writes exactly `n` bytes.
methods.description:
Create a fixed-size `Buffer`/`Uint8Array` encoder that expects exactly `n` bytes.
Throws if the value's `byteLength` does not equal `n`.

methods.name: fixed32
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed 32-byte buffer (e.g. a public key or hash digest).

methods.name: fixed64
methods.description: Encoder for a fixed 64-byte buffer (e.g. a signature).

methods.name: array
methods.returns: An encoder for arrays of values handled by `enc`.
methods.description:
Create an array encoder from an element encoder.
Arrays are length-prefixed with a `uint` element count.

methods.name: frame
methods.returns: An encoder that wraps each value in a byte-length frame.
methods.description:
Create a length-framed encoder from another encoder.
Prepends a `uint` byte-length prefix before the encoded value, so the frame
can be skipped without decoding (useful for streaming protocols).

methods.name: date
methods.description: Encoder for a `Date` object, stored as a signed 64-bit integer millisecond timestamp.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Encoder for any JSON-serialisable value, stored as a length-prefixed UTF-8 string.

methods.name: ndjson
methods.description: Encoder for a JSON value stored as a newline-delimited (NDJSON) length-prefixed UTF-8 string.

methods.name: none
methods.description:
No-op encoder that encodes nothing and always decodes to `null`.
Useful as a placeholder when a value slot should be explicitly absent.

methods.name: any
methods.description:
Encoder for any JSON-representable value (including `Buffer`) stored in a
self-describing compact binary format. Supports `null`, `boolean`, `string`,
`Buffer`, `number`, `Array`, `object`, and `Date`.

methods.name: port
methods.description:
Encoder for a network port number (a 16-bit unsigned integer, 0–65535).
Alias for `cenc.uint16`.

methods.name: ipv4
methods.description: Encoder for an IPv4 address string (e.g. `'127.0.0.1'`) stored as 4 raw bytes.

methods.name: ipv4Address
methods.description:
Encoder for an IPv4 address and port number as `{ host, family, port }`.
Stores the IPv4 address as 4 bytes followed by the port as 2 bytes.

methods.name: ipv6
methods.description: Encoder for an IPv6 address string (e.g. `'::1'`) stored as 16 raw bytes.

methods.name: ipv6Address
methods.description:
Encoder for an IPv6 address and port number as `{ host, family, port }`.
Stores the IPv6 address as 16 bytes followed by the port as 2 bytes.

methods.name: ip
methods.description:
Encoder for a dual IPv4/IPv6 address string. Prefixes the encoding with a
1-byte family tag (`4` or `6`) to distinguish the two families.

methods.name: ipAddress
methods.description:
Encoder for a dual IPv4/IPv6 address and port number as `{ host, family, port }`.
Uses `cenc.ip` for the host and `cenc.port` for the port.

methods.name: record

params.name: keyEncoding
params.description: Encoder used for each object key.

params.name: valueEncoding
params.description: Encoder used for each object value.

methods.returns: An encoder that reads/writes plain objects as key-value pairs.
methods.description:
Create an object encoder from separate key and value encoders.
The object's enumerable own keys are encoded in insertion order, each
prefixed by the key encoding followed by the value encoding.

methods.name: stringRecord
methods.description:
Convenience encoder for a `Record<string, string>` object.
Both keys and values are encoded as length-prefixed UTF-8 strings.

methods.name: from

params.name: enc
params.description: An encoding name, compact encoder, abstract-encoding, or codec.

methods.description:
Adapt an existing codec into a compact-encoding-compatible encoder.
Accepts a named string encoding (`'utf-8'`, `'json'`, etc.), a
compact-encoding encoder (returned as-is), an
[abstract-encoding](https://github.com/mafintosh/abstract-encoding) with
`encodingLength`/`encode`/`decode`, or a
[codecs](https://github.com/mafintosh/codecs)-style codec with `encode`/`decode`.

methods.name: encode

params.name: enc
params.description: A compact-encoding encoder with `preencode` and `encode` methods.

methods.returns: A newly allocated buffer containing the encoded value.
methods.description: Encodes `val` into `state.buffer` at position `state.start`. Updates `state.start` to point after the encoded value when done.

methods.name: decode

params.name: enc
params.description: A compact-encoding encoder with a `decode` method.

methods.description: Decodes a value from `state.buffer` as position `state.start`. Updates `state.start` to point after the decoded value when done in the buffer.

methods.name: preencode
methods.description: Does a fast preencode dry-run that only sets state.end. Use this to figure out how big of a buffer you need.

properties.name: start
properties.description: Byte offset to read/write from. Advances after each encode/decode call.

properties.name: end
properties.description: Byte offset marking the end of valid data. Advances during preencode.

properties.name: buffer
properties.description: The underlying byte buffer. Set to `null` until allocation.
